sn46.14:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn46.14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pīpphaliguhāyaṃ viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn46.14:1.3: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca
sn46.14:2.1: kacci te kassapa khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti. paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn46.14:2.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn46.14:3.1: sattime kassapa bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
sn46.14:3.3: satisambojjhaṅgo kho kassapa mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. pe. upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho kassapa mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn46.14:3.4: ime kho kassapa satta bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.14:4.2: attamano āyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
sn46.14:4.4: tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti.
